followUps.description: Apply linkedFrom/linkType/shortlistId query parameters when creating a next-stage event
followUps.detail: ShortlistDetail.nextStage.createLink for an approved shortlist without a next-stage event is /buyer/tenders/new?linkedFrom=<tenderId>&linkType=next_stage&shortlistId=<id>. CreateTenderPage should prefill the link (or open LinkStageDialog on the new tender). Shortlist 9 of T-2026-0009 now links stage 2 of the same event (no create link).

NegotiationRound and SupplierNegotiationRound now return topics (the authorized topics the round covered, checked against allowedTopics). The blueprint's negotiation_rounds needs a topics text[] column.

Decision owner must hold selection.manage, due-diligence finding owner diligence.manage, negotiator negotiation.conduct, all on the tender team (DECISION_OWNER_NOT_ELIGIBLE, FINDING_OWNER_NOT_ELIGIBLE, NEGOTIATOR_NOT_ELIGIBLE). TenderSelectionSummary.eligible exposes the eligible people; the financial and commercial reviewers are not assignable owners/negotiators in Stage A (no assignment-based read access).

followUps.detail: The only final-offer round (T-2026-0009 variant) is a blocked draft by design (AC-23: BAFO not permitted, reopen-round decision pending), so no supplier can open /supplier/final-offers/1 in the running prototype.
